name: Intercom
tagline: Customer messaging platform API for conversations, contacts, and support automation
description: Intercom provides a REST API for customer messaging, support, and engagement—contacts, conversations, companies, tickets, and help content. Developers use it to sync CRM data, automate messaging, and integrate support workflows with their apps.

auth.details: Bearer token (access token) in Authorization header; create tokens in Intercom Developer Hub / app settings

use_cases: create or update a contact by email
send a reply in a conversation
create a support ticket from app events
